statement: For every k, under i=alpha=k and any eternal k-family F, an active family-relative edge u->x makes J-x+u dominating for every maximum independent k-set J containing x.
dependencies: well-coveredness in the exact form i=alpha=k

supersedes.reason: The original parameter-three theorem was generalized to every k before promotion.

scope_guardrail: The theorem proves domination, not greatest-family membership. The local checker covers only the k=3 specialization and is not an all-graph or all-k certificate.
